page_follows.name: page_follows
page_follows.title: Lifetime Total Follows
page_follows.description: Lifetime: The number of followers of your Facebook Page or profile. This is calculated as the number of follows minus the number of unfollows over the lifetime of your Facebook Page or profile.

page_daily_follows_unique.name: page_daily_follows_unique
page_daily_follows_unique.title: Daily New Follows
page_daily_follows_unique.description: Daily: The number of Meta Accounts that followed your Page in the selected time period. This metric is estimated (Unique Users)

page_daily_unfollows_unique.name: page_daily_unfollows_unique
page_daily_unfollows_unique.title: Daily New Unfollows
page_daily_unfollows_unique.description: Daily: The number of Meta Accounts that unfollowed your Page in the selected time period. This metric is estimated. (Unique Users)

page_media_view.name: page_media_view
page_media_view.title: Visualizaciones de Facebook
page_media_view.description: Número de veces que se mostró en la pantalla de una persona contenido de tu página, incluidas publicaciones, historias, anuncios y otros contenidos.

page_total_media_view_unique.name: page_total_media_view_unique
page_total_media_view_unique.description: Número total de espectadores únicos de contenido multimedia de una página de Facebook

page_post_engagements.name: page_post_engagements
page_post_engagements.title: Daily Post Engagements
page_post_engagements.description: Daily: The number of times people have engaged with your posts through like, comments and shares and more.

page_views_total.name: page_views_total
page_views_total.title: Daily Total views count per Page
page_views_total.description: Daily: Total views count per Page

post_media_view.name: post_media_view
post_media_view.description: Número de veces que se mostró en la pantalla de una persona la publicación de tu página. Las publicaciones incluyen estados, fotos, enlaces, videos y más.

post_clicks.name: post_clicks
post_clicks.title: Lifetime Matched Audience Targeting Consumptions on Post
post_clicks.description: Lifetime: The number of clicks anywhere in your post on News Feed from the user that matched the audience targeting on it. (Total Count)

post_reactions_by_type_total.title: Lifetime Total post Reactions by Type.
post_reactions_by_type_total.description: Lifetime: Total post reactions by type.

reach.name: reach
reach.title: Accounts reached
reach.description: The number of unique accounts that have seen your content, at least once, including in ads. Content includes posts, stories, reels, videos and live videos. Reach is different from impressions, which may include multiple views of your content by the same accounts. This metric is estimated and in development.

views.name: views
views.title: Views
views.description: The number of times your content was played or displayed. Content includes reels, posts, stories.

total_interactions.name: total_interactions
total_interactions.title: Content interactions
total_interactions.description: The total number of post interactions, story interactions, reels interactions, video interactions and live video interactions, including any interactions on boosted content.

accounts_engaged.name: accounts_engaged
accounts_engaged.title: Accounts engaged
accounts_engaged.description: The number of accounts that have interacted with your content, including in ads. Content includes posts, stories, reels, videos and live videos. Interactions can include actions such as likes, saves, comments, shares or replies. These metrics are estimated and in development.

likes.name: likes
likes.title: Likes
likes.description: The number of likes on your posts, reels and videos.

comments.name: comments
comments.title: Comments
comments.description: The number of comments on your posts, reels, videos, and live videos.

shares.name: shares
shares.title: Shares
shares.description: The number of shares of your posts, stories, reels, videos and live videos.

saves.name: saves
saves.title: Saves
saves.description: The number of saves of your posts, reels and videos.

profile_links_taps.name: profile_links_taps
profile_links_taps.title: Profile links taps
profile_links_taps.description: The number of taps on your business address, call button, email button and text button.

follows_and_unfollows.name: follows_and_unfollows
follows_and_unfollows.title: Follows and unfollows
follows_and_unfollows.description: The number of accounts that followed you and the number of accounts that unfollowed you or left Instagram in the selected time period.
